context: ▶ Theorem 5 (The plane test - informal). Fix q, m, d, s such that q is a power of the prime p and s ≤ q. Suppose d < (s − p1 )q. Let C = MRM(q, m, d, s). Then, the plane test is a local characterization for C. See Section 6 for a formal statement. We mention that we do not know if the condition s ≤ q is redundant or not. 1.1.4 Why are planes better than lines? In this subsection, we present an informal discussion on why the line test fails, while the plane test doesn’t.
